evidence.P1: Causal integrity is strong in Crew's War (ev-020→ev-023→ev-025→ev-031→ev-032→ev-036→ev-042) but weak in Neo and Trinity where ev-004→ev-016, ev-017→ev-032 and ev-034→ev-044 are thematic 'because she believed' not enabled by same-plot events, and Matrix ev-018→ev-019 is and-then policing to Sentinel hunt
evidence.P2: Each plot maintains one stance: Neo's Awakening on identity given vs chosen (ev-010 red pill, ev-015 dojo), Crew's War on self-preservation vs sacrifice (ev-020 steak deal vs ev-025 pinning Agent), Morpheus on faith vs proof (ev-016 jump, ev-018 frozen street), Neo/Trinity on doubt vs love, Matrix on truth vs lie — no plot is a neutral retelling
evidence.P3: Membership is mostly accurate but Neo's Awakening omits ev-022 Oracle meeting while ev-023 cites its 'not the One' verdict, and Crew's War omits ev-029 Cypher's murders of Apoc/Switch/Dozer that are the payoff of ev-020's bargain; ev-033/ev-034 assault beats are padded in Neo/Trinity relationship
evidence.P4: Neo's Awakening (ev-004 through ev-045 halting bullets) and Neo/Trinity (ev-004 through ev-047 vigil) complete setup-turns-resolution, but Crew's War ends at ev-042 Sentinel ambush, Morpheus at ev-035 rooftop reinterpretation, and Matrix at ev-043 flight to Room 303 — all dangling before escape/awakening resolution in ev-045/ev-046
evidence.P5: Heavy event reuse (ev-010 in three plots, ev-025 in three plots, ev-032-ev-034 in both Crew's War and Neo/Trinity) is reframed by distinct dilemmas — identity vs faith vs love vs sacrifice vs truth — so plots do not directly rehash one another despite surface overlap

raw.commentary: Hard marking: P1 penalized for relationship and society and-then links despite strong Crew's War chain; P2 holds discipline with distinct throughlines; P3 penalized for missing Oracle meeting and Cypher murders; P4 penalized for three dangling arcs ending at ambush/reinterpretation/flight; P5 retains non-redundancy via distinct dilemmas despite reuse.
